$schema_note: Machine-readable companion to docs/security/secure-image-ingestion-inventory.md. Mirrors the shape/spirit of public-ingress-manifest.json but scoped to image-content safety (format validation, malware scanning, quarantine) rather than general API exposure.

surfaces.name: render-api-analyze
surfaces.malwareScanReason: no clamd instance deployed yet -- see docs/security/malware-scanner-operations.md
surfaces.enforcementNotes: Format/signature/dimension/decode/re-encode/metadata-strip always run once sharp is installed (render.yaml updated, pending owner build verification). Malware scanning is implemented and pluggable but OFF by default until a scanner is deployed. Auth was NOT added -- this endpoint is anonymous by explicit prior design (rate-limited only); adding auth would be a client-visible contract change and is out of scope for this branch.
surfaces.recommendedControl: Owner: verify the Render free-tier build succeeds with sharp, then deploy a clamd instance and flip IMAGE_SCANNER_ENABLED=true.

surfaces.name: style-library-images-add-scan
surfaces.enforcementNotes: New quarantine infrastructure (image-ingestion-quarantine/image-ingestion-clean buckets, image_scan_verdicts table, scan worker) is built and ready, but retrofitting this LIVE client upload call site to use it is a client-visible contract change (upload is no longer instantly usable -- it must wait for a CLEAN verdict). Not done in this branch; flagged for explicit owner decision.
surfaces.recommendedControl: Owner decision required: approve a client-visible contract change to route this upload through the quarantine flow.

surfaces.name: style-library-images-inspiration-upload
surfaces.enforcementNotes: Same gap and same reasoning as style-library-images-add-scan.
surfaces.recommendedControl: Owner decision required: approve a client-visible contract change to route this upload through the quarantine flow.

surfaces.name: tryon-clothes-pro
surfaces.caller: none (services/tryOnClothesPro.ts is unimported anywhere under app/components/hooks/contexts)
surfaces.enforcementNotes: Rewritten to accept only clean_object_id references, resolved against image_scan_verdicts + image-ingestion-clean storage (RLS-scoped ownership, CLEAN verdict, non-expiry, and a SHA-256 hash match against the verdict record) before ever building the upstream RapidAPI request. This full downstream-enforcement rewrite was possible without a client-visible contract change ONLY because the function has no live caller today.
surfaces.recommendedControl: None -- if a live caller is ever wired up, it must upload through the quarantine flow first.

surfaces.name: scan-identify
surfaces.route: not present in supabase/functions/ on this branch
surfaces.enforcementNotes: Referenced pervasively in prior session history as the primary Android/scanner-lineage image-identify endpoint, but has no source directory under supabase/functions/ on ios/full-submission-readiness-v2. Explicitly out of scope for this pass; must go through this same gate before being considered covered if/when that lineage merges here.
surfaces.recommendedControl: Classify and gate at merge time -- do not assume coverage from this pass.

surfaces.name: dormant-expo-router-analyze-api
surfaces.route: app/api/analyze+api.js (no deployment target exists anywhere in this repo)
surfaces.enforcementNotes: Strictly weaker duplicate of render-api-analyze (no rate limit, no size limit, no MIME check at all). Must never be deployed without the same gate applied to /api/analyze.
surfaces.recommendedControl: Consider deleting; if ever deployed, must route through the same ingestion gate first.
